items.quote: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it
items.claim: Moses called Bezaleel, Aholiab, and every wise-hearted man to the work

items.quote: in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom
items.claim: The LORD put wisdom in the hearts of the wise-hearted men

items.quote: which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary
items.claim: The children of Israel brought the offering for the sanctuary work
items.place: for the work of the service of the sanctuary

items.quote: And they received of Moses all the offering
items.claim: They (wise-hearted men) received all the offering from Moses

items.quote: And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning
items.claim: They brought free offerings to Moses every morning
